feature.name: Cast a subset of spells in your graveyard

notablePrerequisites: You have an instant or sorcery card in your graveyard that has legal targets and that can be cast using {B}{B}.
description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the other instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast the other instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the instant or sorcery.
Repeat.

feature.name: Infinite blue mana that can only be spent to cast instant and sorcery spells
Infinite red mana that can only be spent to cast instant and sorcery spells

description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping them, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be used to cast instants or sorceries.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B} targeting Cormela, destroying them and creating two token copies of Cormela with half the destroyed creature's base power and toughness.
Put one of the Cormela tokens in the graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Cormela that died in step 3 and the Cormela that died in step 4 each trigger when they die, returning Dark Ritual and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

feature.name: Near-infinite mana lands you control can produce
Near-infinite untap of lands you control

easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that can tap to produce at least {U}.
description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Frantic Search from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap up to three lands.
Repeat.

Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Cabal Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Cabal Ritual by paying {1}{B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Cabal Ritual, adding at least {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

easyPrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Eternal Witness and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Priest of Gix and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

description:

When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for the additional instant or sorcery and putting it into your hand.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast the additional instant or sorcery by paying at most {B}{B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the additional instant or sorcery.
Repeat.

feature.name: Put a selection of creature cards from your library onto the battlefield

description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Pinnacle Monk, adding one mana of any color.
When Pinnacle Monk dies, The Cauldron of Eternity triggers, putting Pinnacle Monk from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Pinnacle Monk from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Grenzo's ability any number of times.

Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Cabal Ritual, adding at least {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

feature.name: Return all instant and sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand

description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting Scholar of the Ages.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages dies, it triggers, as well as any Wicked Role tokens that may have been attached to it.
Resolve the Wicked Role trigger(s), if applicable, causing each opponent to lose that much life.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard and creating a Wicked Role token attached to it.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Not Dead After All and Dark Ritual to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

description:
Cast Micromancer by paying {3}{U}.
Micromancer enters the battlefield and triggers, searching your library for Dark Ritual and putting it into your hand.
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Micromancer.
Micromancer triggers, searching your library for Scheming Symmetry and putting it into your hand.
Dark Ritual resolves, adding {B}{B}{B} and going to the bottom of your library.
